QuestInfo.name: [Event] March of the Single Yeti Army
QuestInfo.0:
Dr. Kim and Blair need your help. You may have heard that they're just looking for warriors with a lot of free time, 
but you're going to ignore that and see what's up.

#rCaution! You can only participate in this event until 07/22/2014.
QuestInfo.1: It's a shock. Even the Yetis are angered! You understand where they are coming from, but you can't just let them run wild.\r\nDr. Kim gave you a #bBroken Cyclops Eye#k and said it would help you defeat them. Use the #bAgent's Upgrade Chip#k that the Yetis stole\r\nto upgrade it. Get it to its final stage, #bCyclops Eye Lv.3#k, and return to Dr. Kim to get a nice reward.
QuestInfo.2: You got the Cyclops Eye to Lv.3 and showed it to Dr. Kim. He thanked you for your work and gave you a nice gift. But you still feel a little empty inside.. \r\nWhat is this feeling?
